The Trade Storehouse is needed to unpack special trade goods from caravans. Since the AI is a bit stupid in worldgen, civs wont bring many items wanted. You can order them now in crates, under the misc section with the diplomats. Each crate contains a vast amount of items. Different races have different crates to buy.

Crates are unpacked automatically.

I advise to build this building right next to the Trade Depot. For sake of role playing, functionality and building design.
